## Summary

## Tests run

List exact commands and results.

## Correctness and quality impact

Describe behavioral changes, regression controls, full-budget checks, and any
known quality limitations. Write `None` for documentation-only changes.

## Benchmark impact

For performance-related changes, provide before/after results with exact
hardware, model/revision, dtype, context length, generated-token count, batch
size, retrieval budget, configuration, and commit. Otherwise write `Not
performance-related`.

## Research provenance and licensing

Identify originating papers, official repositories/revisions, licenses, and
whether any source is independent, derived, or adapted. Confirm required
notices are preserved. Write `Not applicable` when appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change within KVWeave's current experimental scope.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and evidence boundaries.
- [ ] I did not commit generated benchmark artifacts, model weights, caches, or secrets.
- [ ] I did not make unsupported production, quality, or speedup claims.
